comments.body:
Instead of raising an error (which would display our error report dialog and prompt users to post the problem on Github again), what if we show a QMessageBox with the error, similar to the one in PR #24781?

That way only users interested in seeing the problem solved would post to Github, whereas the rest could ignore it (if we add a `Don't show again` checkbox to the dialog as well).
